_doc: Discipline-scope filter, orthogonal to tool_tiers.json. A tool registers live iff it is tier-1 (see tool_tiers.json) AND its revit_function_registry.json `category` is in the active profile's category set, OR its name is in `always`. This adds no parallel per-tool list: profile membership is derived entirely from the `category` field each tool already carries in revit_function_registry.json.
_composition_rule: Profile filtering can only ever SHRINK what tiering already allows; it never re-exposes a tier2 tool. A tier2 tool stays suppressed regardless of profile and remains reachable via search_revit_api / query_revit_registry / send_code_to_revit no matter which profile is active.
_why_these_five: Mirrors REVIT_MCP_study's full/architect/mep/structural/fire-safety naming now that the tier2 gap-fill (see revit_function_registry.json's _ported_from_revit_mcp_study note) gives mep, structural, facade (architect-only), and compliance (fire-safety-only) categories real content to filter on. Before that gap-fill, every live (tier1) tool belonged to a cross-cutting category, so a profile system would have been a no-op; it now has real, if still tier2-only, payoff, and activates further as tier2 promotions land.
